body:
The CSS Working Group just discussed `Dialog requestClose() getEnabledState behaviour differs between spec and implementations`, and agreed to the following: * `ACTION: lwarlow to update the spec` * `RESOLVED: Make the spec match Chrome / Firefox`
The full IRC log of that discussion <emilio> lwarlow: I've been implementing this in WebKit, and I came by a situation where chrome + firefox behave differently to the spec
<emilio> ... specific about dialog closeby and closewatcher
<emilio> ... safari is correct to the extent it doesn't use closewatcher
<emilio> ... matches the spec kind of by accident
<emilio> ... main issue with the spec is that's IMO badly written
<emilio> ... different to how browsers have implemented it
<emilio> ... the spec uses effectively a callback to switch spec
<emilio> ... the browsers have an enabled flag that they update at various points
<emilio> ... this causes that mismatch
<emilio> ... happy to go with Chrome / FF behavior
<emilio> ... I think if we update the spec to match that seems fine?
<emilio> ... curious if keithamus or others have thoughts
<emilio> keithamus: my thought is we want to add a member variable that's true or false
<emilio> ... I think I raised an issue a long time ago
<emilio> ... which is 11267
<emilio> ... I still maintain that opinion, the spec should be changed
<emilio> lwarlow: ok, happy to write a PR
<bradk> present
<emilio> ... effectively instead of having a "get enabled state" the watcher should have a boolean
<emilio> ... should be easy to write
<emilio> ... happy with that
<emilio> keithamus: how's the behavior observably different?
<emilio> lwarlow: in the example in the spec, the dialog should be closed, but in browsers it isn't
<emilio> ... relatively weird thing to do
<emilio> ... because you remove the closedby attr the get enabled state boolean gets reset
<emilio> ... the fix would be to check whether you're in a requestClose call... I think if requetClose isn't prevented we might want to close? But happy to go with updating the spec to match reality and then figure out changes
<emilio> PROPOSED RESOLUTION: Make the spec match Chrome / Firefox
<emilio> ACTION: lwarlow to update the spec
<lwarlow> +1
<emilio> RESOLVED: Make the spec match Chrome / Firefox
